class.name: ClapInstrumentOutput
class.brief_description: One of a [ClapInstrument]'s outputs beyond the main one, as an audio stream.
class.description: Made by [method ClapInstrument.get_output] (and [method ClapInstrument.bind_outputs]). Play it in a player of its own, on any bus: it sounds that output of the instrument's plugin, in step with the others.

method.name: get_index
